arguments.body: Hi Imogen, thanks for letting us know. Because you've noticed a gassy smell, please treat it as urgent. Please don't use the oven or hob, and don't use any switches, lighters or flames. Open windows and doors, leave the flat, and call the National Gas Emergency line on 0800 111 999 (free, 24 hours). If anyone feels unwell or you're in immediate danger, call 999. Please don't go back in until the gas engineer says it's safe. We're arranging an engineer to look at the oven and the smell as a priority, and we'll be in touch again today. Please reply to let us know you're safe.

arguments.body: Hi Imogen, thanks for letting us know. Because you've noticed a gassy smell, please treat it as urgent. Please don't use the oven or hob, and don't use any switches, lighters or flames. Open windows and doors, leave the flat, and call the National Gas Emergency line on 0800 111 999 (free, 24 hours). If anyone feels unwell or you're in immediate danger, call 999. Please don't go back in until the gas engineer says it's safe. We're arranging an engineer to look at the oven and the smell as a priority, and we'll be in touch again today. Please reply to let us know you're safe.
